description: Create a pending shipper deployment for ingest setup. Captures initiating_client_id from authenticated_principal as the ownership-binding seed (spec §13.3). Validates the requested sources against IngestSourceKind, generates machine_id binding, and returns {deployment_id, machine_id, authorized_source_kinds} for the operator-side shipper installer to consume. Part of M5 shipper bootstrap pairing flow.
